answer: Start from Tellor attestation of identity. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 604 keys multiplies the price 604-fold: 64628 POA locked, or 7852 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One spiral of signal, one ripple of cost, one walnut of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
